## Problem and scope

What problem does this PR solve? What is intentionally outside its scope?

## Evidence

List commands run, results, and any browser or local-backend checks. Link the relevant specification/plan and describe review findings and fixes.

## Risks and follow-up

State known limits, unrun checks, external dependencies and the next slice.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff contains no real credentials, proprietary identifiers or copied business data.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is accessible by keyboard and at narrow widths where relevant.
- [ ] Relevant tests and lint, typecheck and build passed; failures are explained.
- [ ] Documentation matches implemented behavior; planned features are not claimed as working.
